characters.summary: The Immortal Hulk form emphasizes the Green Door and true immortality, granting Bruce Banner the ability to regenerate from absolute destruction and manifesting monstrous, highly intelligent transformations.

mechanisms: Absolute physical regeneration from skeletons and decapitation

limitations: Dependent on the Green Door mechanism to return from the Below-Place
characters.formDifferences: Embodies the supernatural, horrific aspects of the Hulk persona tied to the Below-Place and absolute regeneration.

sources.supports: Overview of the Immortal Hulk series, themes of immortality and the Green Door.

notableResults.note: Hulk defeats Thor using specialized physical force.

unknowns: Exact limits of gamma output compared to World Breaker Hulk

characters.summary: Maestro Hulk is a future alternate version of the Hulk who retains all of Bruce Banner's genius intellect alongside the amplified strength of a centuries-worth of absorbed nuclear radiation.

mechanisms: Extreme durability enhanced by absorbed radiation

limitations: Arrogance can lead to underestimating opponents
characters.formDifferences: Combines the standard Hulk's immense physical power with a ruthless, highly intelligent tactical mind and future weaponry.

sources.supports: Maestro's origin, intellect, and physical capabilities.

notableResults.note: Conquered most Earth heroes and established a dystopia.

unknowns: Exact upper limits of his radiation absorption capacity

characters.summary: World Breaker Hulk is fueled by unbearable grief and rage, releasing continuous gamma radiation powerful enough to shatter tectonic plates and level landmasses merely by stepping.
weaknesses: Vulnerability to specialized energy draining when not at peak rage
limitations: Unstable state driven by extreme grief and rage
characters.formDifferences: Massive increase in ambient gamma radiation emission that actively destroys the surrounding environment just by proximity.

sources.supports: World War Hulk storyline detailing World Breaker capabilities.

notableResults.note: Hulk drains Red Hulk's energy and defeats him.

unknowns: Whether he can sustain this form indefinitely without intervention

limitations: Flame output depends on available oxygen

weaknesses: Vulnerable when distracted or emotionally unbalanced
limitations: Chi requires time to recharge after heavy usage

weaknesses: Human pilot vulnerability inside the suit
limitations: Energy consumption tied to reactor capacity

characters.summary: The Bleeding Edge armor is stored inside Tony Stark's own body as nanotechnology, allowing him to manifest weapons, shields, and tools instantly from his skin.
limitations: Vulnerable to magnetic manipulation that disrupts nanites
characters.formDifferences: Replaces standard modular mechanical armor with real-time controllable nanotechnology stored internally.

sources.supports: Overview of Iron Man armor variants including Bleeding Edge.

unknowns: Exact mass limits of generated nano-constructs
